parameters.query:
=SELECT u.id, u.name, u.user_type 
FROM user_credentials uc 
JOIN users u ON uc.user_id = u.id 
WHERE LOWER(uc.username) = LOWER('{{$node["Webhook - Login"].json["body"]["username"]}}') 
  AND uc.password = '{{$node["Webhook - Login"].json["body"]["password"]}}' 
LIMIT 1;
